title: Russian Beef Papillote with Juicy Vegetables
description: A flavorful and healthy dish where beef and vegetables are cooked in a sealed pouch to retain moisture and flavors.
instructions: Season the beef with salt and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Sear the beef for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the beef to a piece of parchment paper or aluminum foil, leaving a 1-inch border around it.
Arrange the chopped carrots, onions, and potatoes around the beef.
Fold the parchment paper or foil over the beef and vegetables, creating a sealed pouch.
Place the papillote on a baking sheet and bake for 25-30 minutes or until the beef reaches an internal temperature of 135°F (57°C) for medium-rare.
Remove the papillote from the oven and let it rest for 5-10 minutes.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
